resources.string: YouTube, YouTube Music and Reddit updates

These apps come with the ROM. They are normal apps: uninstall any of them like any other app and it won\'t come back unless you install it again here. Updates are checked every few hours and installed automatically.
Install new versions in the background
Installed from another source, not managed here
A different MicroG (%1$s) is installed. YouTube and YouTube Music only work with the official MicroG-RE: uninstall it, then install MicroG-RE here.
%1$s stops YouTube and YouTube Music from signing in. Tap to replace it with the official MicroG-RE.
